Lands' End: Quality Clothing, Apparel, Outerwear and Footwear

Fall has a way of bringing everyone back into rhythm. Crisp mornings, packed school schedules, weekend football games and neighborhood bonfires all call for clothing that feels ready for the season. At Lands' End, we build our fall collections around those real-life moments, so your family can head into cooler days with layers that feel warm, reliable and easy to wear.

From early-morning commutes to late-night porch conversations, our fall pieces blend everyday comfort with lasting quality. We designed this season's lineup to keep up with full days, shifting temperatures and busy evenings alike, so you can focus on the plans ahead and leave the fuss behind.

Fall Clothing for Every Wardrobe

Fall fills up fast with school routines, workdays, weekend getaways and traditions you look forward to all year. Our fall collections for women, men and kids are built around that energy, blending dependable comfort with put-together details that work from chilly mornings to well past dark. Wherever the day takes your family, Lands' End has the pieces to keep everyone comfortable and looking great.

Everyday Fall Looks for Women

The Lands' End women's clothing collection captures that cozy fall feeling in feel-good fabrics you'll reach for again and again. Imagine browsing a harvest market in a soft sweater that layers neatly under a jacket, or meeting friends for dinner in a knit top paired with cords or classic chinos.

For busier days, long-sleeve tees and button-front shirts pair naturally with denim, trousers or casual skirts for a look that stays polished without trying too hard. From school drop-off to Saturday evening gatherings, you'll find seasonal colors, easy layers and flattering silhouettes that turn ordinary fall days into standout ones.

Men's Styles That Keep Up with Fall

Crafted for the rhythm of fall, the Lands' End men's clothing collection keeps pace from early tee times to easy evening hangouts on the deck. Flannel shirts, soft sweaters and dependable polos layer well under jackets and vests, while our tailored-fit pants and classic jeans bring just enough polish for impromptu dinner plans.

For low-key weekends, soft cotton tees and laid-back knit layers handle everything from Saturday farmers' market runs to afternoons spent grilling with the neighbors. These are the kind of reliable fall staples that feel right every time you put them on.

Kids' Styles for School Days and Playtime

Fall means busy schedules for kids, and their wardrobes should keep that same energy going. The kids' clothing collection from Lands' End delivers comfort and durability built for school days, playground adventures and weekend family plans.

Soft graphic tees in eye-catching colors hold up to long days of recess and after-school activities. Easy-on dresses with playful prints look just as cute at a fall festival as they do on a family road trip. Pull-on pants, fleece layers and cozy hoodies give kids total freedom to run, climb and stay warm when the air turns crisp. Every piece is made to handle real kid adventures while still looking great in family photos.

Fall Fits for Every Body Type

At Lands' End, we know that great clothing starts with a great fit. That's why we offer sizing built around real body proportions, so everyone in the family can enjoy fall in pieces that feel made for them. Our regular sizes provide a reliable, go-to fit for everyday wear. Plus-size options bring the same style and ease in cuts designed to flatter fuller figures.

We also pay close attention to smaller proportions. Our petite sizes are tailored for smaller frames, so nothing feels oversized or overwhelming. Our tall sizes feature thoughtful adjustments for longer torsos, sleeves and extended inseams. With this kind of sizing commitment, Lands' End makes sure nobody has to compromise fit to get the fall wardrobe they want.

Outerwear for Every Fall Forecast

Nothing says fall quite like that first cool morning or a windy walk through changing leaves. At Lands' End, our outerwear collections are designed around real weather and real routines, giving your whole family jackets, coats and fleece layers that look great and hold up season after season.

Thoughtfully Designed Outerwear for Women

Designed for every way you move through the season, the Lands' End women's outerwear collection brings a range of styles that fit the moment. Lightweight rain jackets, cozy fleece pullovers, quilted jackets and warm down coats all feature thoughtful construction that balances coverage, comfort and easy movement. Head out for a morning walk, then stay ready for errands, workdays and weekend plans without switching layers.

Waterproof finishes, packable designs and insulating details help you handle shifting forecasts with confidence, while classic colors and seasonal textures let your personal style lead the way. From light fall showers to the first real cold snap, these are layers made to keep up.

Men's Outerwear That Keeps Up All Season

Designed for every fall forecast, the Lands' End men's outerwear collection keeps up from weekday commutes to hours outside with family and friends. Classic Squall jackets, fleece layers, packable down jackets and durable parkas come in practical silhouettes built for comfort, coverage and everyday wear.

Neutral shades pair well with jeans, cords and chinos, while weather-ready details help you move through rain, wind and cooler temperatures without overthinking the day. From light jackets to warmer insulated options, these are the layers men can count on all season long.

Kids' Outerwear for Every Fall Adventure

Kids live for outdoor fun in fall, and their outerwear should match that enthusiasm. Our boys' and girls' outerwear collections feature bold colors, playful patterns and comfortable fits that hold up through recess, leaf piles, school walks and weekend adventures.

Fleece jackets and pullovers give kids easy warmth for mild days, while rain jackets and insulated coats help them stay ready when the forecast changes. Durable fabrics and kid-friendly details make every layer easy to wear, easy to love and ready for one more trip outside.

Outerwear for Every Temperature

From light fleece layers to serious cold-weather coats, Lands' End outerwear franchises are designed to help you choose the right level of warmth for the forecast. Each collection brings its own mix of comfort, coverage and weather-ready details, making it easy to find dependable outerwear for every fall and winter plan.

Anyweather Fleece: The Cozy First Layer

Anyweather Fleece is the easy first layer for mild fall days, cool mornings and casual time outdoors. This fleece maintains color and softness while providing depdendable, ultra-lightweight warmth. Anti-pill and antistatic finishes help the fleece stay fresh and easy to wear, making it a natural choice for school drop-offs, errands, walks and relaxed weekends.

Squall Rain Coats: Ready When the Forecast Turns

Squall rain coats step up the protection when fall brings wind, rain and unpredictable weather. Windproof and waterproof coverage, reinforced with sealed seams, helps keep the elements out when the forecast turns rough. With insulation options ranging from lightweight raincoats to cold-weather winter parkas, Squall styles make it easier to choose the right level of protection for commutes, school days, sideline cheering and weekend plans.

Wanderweight Packable Down: Warmth That Travels Light

Wanderweight packable down is made for lightweight warmth that goes wherever the day takes you. Filled with 800 fill power RDS HyperDRY™ down and finished with a water-repellent shell, it delivers dependable comfort without bulky weight. The packable design makes it easy to bring along on road trips, weekend getaways and busy days when the forecast can change fast.

FeatherFree Insulation: Down-Free Warmth for Chilly Days

FeatherFree insulation delivers lightweight warmth with down-free insulation that helps you stay comfortable as temperatures drop. Water-resistant protection adds everyday confidence when the forecast turns damp, while the easy-to-wear design gives families a dependable option for cooler fall days and the first cold snaps of the season.

Max 600 Fill Down: Serious Warmth for Cold Forecasts

Max 600 Fill Down brings serious warmth for colder fall days and the transition into winter. Extra-fill insulation helps hold in dependable warmth, while a water-resistant finish adds protection when flurries or damp weather move in. Adjustable hoods offer added coverage, and select styles include removable faux fur for a classic cold-weather look with flexible styling.

Expedition: Peak Protection for Deep Winter

Expedition outerwear delivers peak warmth for the toughest cold-weather solution in the Lands' End lineup. Premium down insulation helps hold in serious heat when temperatures drop, while sealed seams add windproof and waterproof protection against harsh winter conditions. Built for deep cold, long days outside and the kind of weather that calls for your most dependable coat, Expedition styles bring maximum coverage when it matters most.

Stylish Shoes Ready for Every Autumn Adventure

From those first crisp fall days to chilly autumn nights, our versatile collection of Women's Shoes brings comfort, style and everyday ease to the season. Shop women's boots, loafers, flats, slippers and all-weather footwear made for everything from weekday routines to weekend plans. Our Women's Fashion Boots pair beautifully with jeans, leggings, sweater dresses, skirts and polished workwear, while Women's Loafers and ballet flats add timeless style to casual days, office outfits and dinner plans. When the forecast looks wet and rainy, Women's Rain Boots and weather-ready styles help keep feet warm, dry and comfortable with smart details like cushioned insoles, cozy linings and weather-resistant designs. From quick errands and school drop-offs to nights out and weekend getaways, Lands' End women's footwear is ready to step into fall with comfort, confidence and easy seasonal style.

From muddy yardwork to pre-gaming with the guys, men can count on our complete selection of Men's Shoes for comfort, durability and easygoing style. Shop men's boots, duck boots, casual shoes, slippers and cool-season footwear built for everything from weekday errands and relaxed workplaces to dog walks and nights around the firepit. Men's boots and casual moc toe styles pair naturally with jeans, chinos, flannel shirts, sweaters and jackets, while weather-ready duck boots help handle rain, mud and puddles like it's their job. For after-hours comfort, men's slippers are the warm pick for quiet mornings, football weekends and quick trips to the mailbox. Wherever fall takes you, Lands' End men's footwear is like that reliable friend who shows up with traction, comfort and no complaints.

Your little ones can stay ready for school days and every adventure with comfortable, durable styles in a wide range of Kids' Shoes. Shop kids' boots, chukkas, Chelsea boots, Mary Janes and autumn-ready footwear made for class, recess, playdates, family outings and seasonal fun. Kids' fall shoes pair easily with school uniforms, jeans, leggings, dresses and cozy layers, while weather-ready boots help keep little feet warm, dry and comfortable when crisp weather arrives. From easy-on designs and cushioned insoles to grippy outsoles and soft linings, Lands' End kids' footwear is built for busy mornings, active days and the kind of seasonal fun that can sometimes involve puddles and leaf piles. Wherever fall leads, Lands' End shoes help kids enjoy the season with comfort, warmth and style.

Experience the Lands' End Difference This Fall

Choosing Lands' End this fall means choosing lasting quality, thoughtful design and genuine care in every layer. From crisp mornings to cozy weekends, our clothing, outerwear and footwear are made to help your family move through the season with comfort and confidence. When you shop with Lands' End, you can count on pieces built for real life, real weather and the traditions that make fall worth looking forward to.
